_doc: The Bailiff Shield (Project Redmond R3, gadgets/R3_OPERATORS.md §2; Ulo's: the stun and the slow, set down, and the EMP shock that makes it hers): Bailiff's primary. A full-height plate held with her sidearm, as Fuze's is (the sidearm fires aimed only). Not aimed, Fire holds its prod out at the plate's edge: a jolt every `prod.everyS` into the first body of the other side within `prod.rangeM` and `prod.halfDeg` of the view (in sight): `prod.damage`, and slowed to `prod.slowMul` (no sprint, no vault) for `prod.slowS`; the prod runs on `prod.chargeS` of charge that refills at a second a second once it's been off `prod.refillDelayS`. The prod is electronic: an EMP on her turns it off for its seconds, and one reaching her while she holds the shield up shocks her: she can't move or use her hands for `prod.shockS`. Her ability item sets the shield down as standing cover where she faces (data/gadgets/bailiff_post.json), and she picks it up again (F). Its plate and every number of the prod are ours.
name: Bailiff Shield
